public/brands/index.html.raw: sol pbc is a colorado public benefit corporation building open-source, privacy-respecting tools for digital self-determination, letting individuals directly collect and gain insight from their personal data. the company's flagship product is solstone, an open-source, local-first personal journal platform. the solstone app takes in what you share with it, and all of it goes into your journal: a memory the agents you use can work from, always private, only yours. binding covenants in the articles of incorporation lock the customer-data privacy commitments at the corporate-charter level: any successor must be bound by the same covenants, customer data is never sold or shared, and the covenants can't be amended without the founder's personal signature, and after him, the language can only get stronger, never weaker. founded by jer (creator of XMPP/Jabber) in 2026.
